CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to identified content; A absent.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red/blue) plus organization/presentation (coordinate listings) and separate origin/status fields are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: Report explicitly names contents 'red' and 'blue' with coordinate attribute listings under current records.

D.rationale: Origin/record metadata (kind/record_time/represented_time) separates content listing from its record/status information.

O.rationale: Text states how content is presented (grid orientation and explicit coordinate listings for contents) and includes 'current' presentation records.
